description: Regression gate for semantic embeddings without a reranker (fastembed bge-small-en-v1.5, hybrid). Calibrated on golden_v2 at hit_rate 0.987 / recall 0.987 / MRR 0.932 overall, with 7 of 18 unanswerable questions abstained at retrieval. Run with RAG_RUN_LIVE_TESTS=1 (downloads the model; free).
